import numpy as np, itertools
t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
cands={'1':np.ones_like(t),'1/t':1/t,'1/t2':1/t**2,'logt':np.log(t),'sqrt':np.sqrt(t),'t':t,'t2':t**2,'1/sqrt':1/np.sqrt(t),'t1.5':t**1.5,'1/t1.5':t**-1.5,'exp-t':np.exp(-t),'log2':np.log(t)**2}
must=[cands['1'],cands['1/t'],cands['logt'],cands['sqrt'],cands['t'],A**2*np.sqrt(t)]
keys=[k for k in cands if k not in ('1','1/t','logt','sqrt','t')]
best=[]
for r in [1,2]:
    for S in itertools.combinations(keys,r):
        X=np.column_stack(must+[cands[k] for k in S])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
        res=np.mean((y-X@c)**2)/np.var(y)
        best.append((res,S,np.round(c[-r:],4)))
best.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
for b in best[:8]: print(b)
